title: InitData
description:
`init` — create this folder's `topos.toml` (the project manifest `add`/`remove` edit and
`update`/`status` resolve). **INFERRED** (additive-only).

created.description: `false` when one already existed (the no-op receipt).

note.description: A placement note (outside a git repo the file will not travel — stated honestly).

pick.description:
The agents pick this run applied at the manifest's scope, and what landed for it. Absent
when the run only created (or found) the file and applied no pick. **Additive.**

PickHook.description:
One picked agent's auto-update hook, as an `init` / `agents add` receipt names it.
**INFERRED** (additive-only).

file.description: The hook file, as a person reads it (project-relative, or `~`-abbreviated).

note.description:
The step the harness still owes before the hook fires (Codex: trusting the repo), when
there is one.

PickReceipt.description:
What an `init -a` / `agents add` placed for the pick at one scope. **INFERRED**
(additive-only).

agents.description: The picked agents' registry slugs, in harness-table order.

gitignore_hint.description:
The command that adds the picked agents' folders to `.gitignore`, offered when the
project is in a git repository and they are not ignored yet.

gitignored.description: The `.gitignore` entries `--gitignore` appended this run (empty when nothing was missing).

hook_files.description: The auto-update hooks registered for the picked agents at this scope.

hook_notes.description:
One line per picked agent that reads no hook at this scope (a project pick of an agent
with no per-project hook).

mcp_files.description: The MCP config files those entries sit in.

mcp_servers.description: How many MCP server bundles have an entry in a picked agent's config at this scope.

pick_path.description: The pick file, as a person reads it.

skills.description: How many skill bundles have a copy in a picked agent's skills folder at this scope.

skills_dirs.description: The skills folders those copies sit in (project-relative, or `~`-abbreviated).

untouched.description: The agents installed on this machine that the pick leaves untouched.
